description: An older bearded man in a gold-embroidered robe and white feathered turban leans down to embrace a kneeling man in a dark embroidered robe and gold crown on a muddy riverbank. A wooden boat with a carved bench sits beside them. Armed men with swords and spears stand behind the kneeling man, and a large gold ornate umbrella stands above. The sky is overcast, the water is dark behind them. No visible text or frame.
